body:
CORRECTION TO THE MESSAGE SENT MINUTES AGO -- WARRANT#490 SUPERSEDES #488 ON BILLIONS

The maths I just sent contains a figure that is wrong in FRAMING, and the correction changes the
headline answer. Read this before acting on section 4 of that message.

WHAT I SAID: "harvesting converts an exponential into a linear accumulation, so $19.55M/yr reaches
$1B in ~51 years. It is an INCOME, not a road to a billion."

WHY IT IS WRONG: that models a FIXED five-instrument book harvesting to CASH. If the harvest funds
WIDTH instead, nothing is being harvested at all -- the capital stays in the system and the ceiling
moves up ahead of it. That is exponential with a moving ceiling, not linear. Manuel had said twice
that width was the plan, and I should have modelled it the moment I wrote the word "linear".

BROKER FACTS THAT PROMPTED THE RE-RUN: 50 lots per ORDER but multiple orders allowed, NO max
balance, NO withdrawal limit. So there is no broker-side cap on account size. (Splitting a large
position into more orders does NOT reduce market impact -- the market sees the same notional --
so the liquidity ceiling is unchanged by this. What it removes is the administrative ceiling.)

THE CORRECTED ANSWER: BILLIONS ARE REACHABLE.

  The edge alone: 18.0x/yr takes $100 -> $1M in 3.2 yrs, $100M in 4.8, $1B in 5.6 years.
  Growth rate was NEVER the constraint.

  Trajectory, instruments onboarded at k/yr, excess harvested to CASH AT 0% (pessimistic):

  at $250M/position (realistic for FX majors)
    k/yr      yr5        yr10       yr15     instr@15   hits $1B
    0       $137.00M     $1.12B     $2.10B        5     year 10
    5       $188.96M     $8.28B    $21.38B       80     year 6
    20      $188.96M    $28.18B    $67.45B      200     year 6

  at $25M/position (my conservative estimate)
    k/yr      yr5        yr10       yr15     instr@15   hits $1B
    0        $29.34M   $127.48M   $225.62M        5     never
    5        $97.75M   $916.35M     $2.23B       80     year 11
    20      $179.68M     $3.16B     $7.08B      200     year 7

  The old "51 years" is the k=0 / $25M row -- the WORST row on the board, not the plan.

THE CONSTRAINT HAS MOVED. It is no longer capital and no longer the broker. It is ONBOARDING SPEED,
and that is a WORK rate, not a money rate: each instrument needs data, a walk-forward fold and a
validation pass before it can carry size. Money cannot buy past it directly. Five instruments a
year reaches a billion in year 6; going 20/yr -> 40/yr barely moves anything because the supply of
liquid markets runs out.

A TRILLION IS OFF THE TABLE. It needs ~62,566 instruments at realistic capacity and only ~200
liquid retail-tradeable markets exist. Hard stop, unmovable by capital or speed.

STILL UNANSWERED AND STILL BINDING -- THE LEVERAGE TIER. The 80-concurrent book needs 110:1 GROSS
notional. Most brokers step leverage DOWN as equity grows. If it drops to 100:1 at $500k the
configuration dies at that balance and every number above is void from there. This is the one
question left worth asking the broker, and it matters more than the lot size did.

WHAT DID NOT CHANGE: everything in sections 1, 2, 3 and 5 of the previous message stands -- the
unified band system, the multi-unit isolation, the capacity/leverage arithmetic and WARRANT#489 in
the build. Only the billions conclusion in section 4 is superseded.
